title: Peek: Cannot Use Arrow Keys to Cycle Through and Preview Multiple Files in a Folder
author: 7AvbOEZM9xEvXdN
summary: After a PDF inside Peek receives focus, arrow keys scroll the embedded document instead of moving the Explorer selection to preview adjacent files.
next_action: Consolidate the PDF arrow-key case into #27017 and preserve it as an acceptance scenario.

confidence.rationale: The issue and comment explicitly identify the same open WebView2 focus problem.

judgment.rationale: The report names #27017, and the discussion identifies the same open WebView2 keyboard-focus/shortcut swallowing mechanism.
evidence: Arrow-key navigation works until the user clicks inside the PDF preview.
After focus enters the PDF, Down scrolls the document instead of selecting the next file.
A maintainer participant identifies Edge WebView2 focus as the cause; #27017 remains open for shortcuts swallowed by WebView2.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate the PDF arrow-key case into #27017 and preserve it as an acceptance scenario.

fix_assessment.rationale: The active WebView2 shortcut tracker already owns the underlying focus-routing defect.

issue_context.summary: After a PDF inside Peek receives focus, arrow keys scroll the embedded document instead of moving the Explorer selection to preview adjacent files.
known_information: The original affected version is PowerToys 0.71.0.
The reproduction uses multi-page PDF files.
The issue itself links #27017 as related.
inferences: The embedded PDF WebView consumes navigation keys after focus transfer before Peek's folder-navigation command can handle them.
issue_context.analysis: One WebView2 focus/shortcut fix should be validated against both generic shortcuts and this PDF navigation scenario.
initial_investigation: Read the complete report and all comments.
Verified #27017 remains open and tracks Peek shortcuts swallowed by WebView2.

actions.label: Consolidate with Peek WebView2 issue 27017

comment.body: This PDF case matches the WebView2 focus-routing problem tracked in #27017: after focus enters the embedded document, arrow keys are consumed for PDF scrolling instead of reaching Peek's adjacent-file navigation. Please consolidate this report into #27017 and keep the exact click-PDF-then-Down sequence as an acceptance test for that fix.
